title: Get This Free Service in the City of San Diego!
description:
It’s Digital Inclusion Week! The City of San Diego is committed to bridging the digital divide. Through SD Access 4 All, we offer:

Free public Wi-Fi hotspots
One-on-one help from a Digital Navigator
Low-cost computers for qualified residents (inventory may vary).

🔗Learn more: sandiego.gov/sdaccess  
#DigitalInclusionWeek #SDAccess4All #DIW2025
